exec: pm.test("Required headers and examples", () => { ['transactions','refunds'].forEach(endpoint => { const op = b.paths['/api/payments/{paymentId}/' + endpoint].post; pm.expect(op.parameters.find(p => p.name === 'Idempotency-Key').required).to.eql(true); pm.expect(op.requestBody.content['application/json'].example).to.exist; }); });
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Create payment') { pm.collectionVariables.set('runId', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}')); pm.collectionVariables.set('bookingId', String(Date.now())); }
